summary.text: Mary Felzkowski is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 12, based in Tomahawk.
She was elected to the Assembly in 2012 and to the Senate in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Felzkowski was born in Tomahawk, Wisconsin, on September 25, 1963, and is married with five children and four grandchildren.
She graduated from Tomahawk High School in 1981 and earned a B.S. in finance and economics from the University of Wisconsin-River Falls in 1986.
The Legislature's page lists her as an insurance agency owner and a former president of Tomahawk Main Street, Inc. and of Tomahawk Child Care.
She is a former president and national director of the Professional Insurance Agents of Wisconsin.

She served in the Assembly from 2012 to 2018, as Assistant Majority Leader in 2019, and in the Senate she chairs the Special Committee on Oversight of the Department of Justice and co-chairs the Joint Committee on Employment Relations.
